more_beautiful.reason: B is cohesive and polished from top to bottom, with a characterful slab serif, a warm rust/mustard/green palette, clear hierarchy and a well-structured stepped booking form at both widths; A has one lovely hanging-tag hero but the rest is sparse, with large empty gaps, an off-palette default-blue button, a slot strip with open bottom edges, oddly early line wraps in the 'can't take' list and 'Something else' spilling out of its card.

less_generic.reason: A builds the whole page around a hand-hung manila repair tag (hero, booking form and logo) and skips the usual landing-page formula, while B, despite its luggage tag and perforated 'repair ticket', follows the familiar AI-site template of a small all-caps label above the headline, a two-colour slogan headline, two buttons, a dotted background, 1-2-3 step cards, icons in tinted squares, an FAQ accordion and a dark footer.
